description: Set which US states you have economic nexus in. Sellers must configure nexus to get non-zero sales tax results. Merge semantics: only the states you send change; send hasNexus:false to remove one. Requires API key.

hasNexus.description: Whether you have nexus in this state

reason.description: Reason for nexus (e.g. 'Economic nexus — over $100K revenue')

nexus.description: State codes as keys, e.g. { TX: { hasNexus: true, reason: '...' } }

name: configure_nexus
title: Configure your nexus states
